passages.text: When I join the chess club, I want to make friends as well as learn the game. At the first meeting, I sit alone because I am unsure how to join a table. The leader suggests asking one player whether I may watch the end of a game. I decide to take her advice and ask politely instead of waiting for someone to notice me. The player makes room, explains the final moves and invites me to try the next game. By the time the meeting ends, I know two names and have a reason to look forward to returning.

parallelText.en: When I join the chess club, I want to make friends as well as learn the game.
parallelText.zh: 加入国际象棋社团时，我既想交朋友，也想学棋。

parallelText.en: At the first meeting, I sit alone because I am unsure how to join a table.
parallelText.zh: 第一次活动时，我独自坐着，不知道怎样加入别人。

parallelText.en: The leader suggests asking one player whether I may watch the end of a game.
parallelText.zh: 负责人建议我问一位棋手，能否观看一盘棋的最后部分。

parallelText.en: I decide to take her advice and ask politely instead of waiting for someone to notice me.
parallelText.zh: 我决定听从她的建议，礼貌询问，而不是等别人注意到我。

parallelText.en: The player makes room, explains the final moves and invites me to try the next game.
parallelText.zh: 那位棋手腾出位置，解释最后几步，并邀请我下一盘试试。

parallelText.en: By the time the meeting ends, I know two names and have a reason to look forward to returning.
parallelText.zh: 活动结束时，我认识了两位成员，也有了期待下次再来的理由。

passages.text: Our group is running late while setting up chairs for a school event. One pupil begins to shout at his partner because a row is in the wrong place. The leader steps in and says, “Take it easy; let us check the plan before moving anything else.” They discover that the two pupils were looking at different versions of the seating plan. The leader gives everyone the current version, and the pupil apologises for raising his voice. Working from the same plan, the group corrects the row and finishes the setup together.

parallelText.en: Our group is running late while setting up chairs for a school event.
parallelText.zh: 我们小组为学校活动摆椅子时进度落后了。

parallelText.en: One pupil begins to shout at his partner because a row is in the wrong place.
parallelText.zh: 一位学生因为一排椅子位置不对而冲搭档嚷嚷。

parallelText.en: The leader steps in and says, “Take it easy; let us check the plan before moving anything else.”
parallelText.zh: 负责人介入，说：“别着急，继续搬之前先看看平面图。”

parallelText.en: They discover that the two pupils were looking at different versions of the seating plan.
parallelText.zh: 他们发现，两位学生看的座位图版本不同。

parallelText.en: The leader gives everyone the current version, and the pupil apologises for raising his voice.
parallelText.zh: 负责人给大家当前版本，那位学生为高声嚷嚷道歉。

parallelText.en: Working from the same plan, the group corrects the row and finishes the setup together.
parallelText.zh: 根据同一张图，小组改正那排椅子，一起完成布置。
